Set up this store — load your bins and products, print labels, export what you recorded
1  Store code
The three letters from the Dynamics store code — EMP for S2004EMP. It goes on the shop floor, dock and write-off labels; bin labels carry the bin's own code (GF1-R01-S01-B01).
The full Dynamics store number. It picks this store's rows out of a sales file.
2  Bins — load the store's bin list
The Excel file (.xlsx, or .csv), one row per bin: stockroom, rack, shelf, bin, category, capacity (units it holds). Rack, shelf and bin can be written R01 or 1. Each bin's code is built from them: GF1-R01-S01-B01. Or one bin code column with that code. Replaces the bins below — for the first time, or to correct them; it warns first if a bin that holds stock would go.
2b  Or lay out racks as a block
A block is racks of one category: every rack gets the shelves, every shelf the bins, every bin the capacity. Codes run GF1-R01-S01-B01, GF1-R01-S01-B02 … Each block adds to the list; racks that differ are another block. A shelf holds one category.
No bins yet.
3  Products
The Dynamics item master (“Item - bar code” export, .xlsx), exactly as downloaded — about a minute to read. It gives every product its bar code, name, size, category, design (search name) and, for kits, how many pieces they hold. Or a CSV with columns barcode, sku, description, category, size.
3b  Send the product list to all stores
Each week, after loading the new item master: type the HQ password and send. Every store laptop picks it up the next time it is open with internet, in the background — nobody has to load the item master at the stores. Products recorded in stock keep their place: a product is its bar code.
4  Labels
Stick one on each bin. Nothing can be scanned until they are up.
4b  Sales → refill list
Never refilled from a bin: items starting with these (bags, boxes).
Sales files are loaded from the Refill list on the main screen, so the store can load them without setup.
5  Get your data back
Opens straight in Excel. Export before you clear anything.
6  Sending to the server
Every movement, count and unrecognised scan is kept on this laptop and sent to the Google Sheet when there is a connection. Scanning never waits for it. Setting it up: server/SETUP.md.
